stages.note: Play the opening and finish Chapter 1. Before the chapter ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation — it is the only thing in the game that can be missed outright. Beat Cal at fishing and finish an arcade game while you are here.
stages.title: Stage 1 — Chapter 1: play the opening, save the meditation

stages.note: Character switching between Jason and Lucia opens up, unlocking the partner trophies. Rob Kingpin Bowling for the bowling trophy, buy the eight garages, and start registering vehicles with Scooter Bros.
stages.title: Stage 2 — Chapter 2: two protagonists, garages and bowling

stages.note: The Snap Gun arrives with Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — use it for a clean, undetected jewelry robbery. Run Yago's street-racing strand and do the time-sensitive Race Against Yago the moment it appears.
stages.title: Stage 3 — Chapter 3: jewelry, partner robberies, Yago's race

stages.note: Near the end of the chapter, the optional mission That's Where The Money Is opens the bank-vault jobs. Bring your partner: vault jobs give a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one earns Hot Together too. Keep an untouched save from just before the final mission.
stages.title: Stage 4 — Chapter 4: bank vaults and the pre-finale save

stages.note: Finish the final mission for the gold trophy. Everything outside the story stays open after the credits, so the cleanup can all wait until now.
stages.title: Stage 5 — The final mission

stages.note: After the credits, finish the six side-story finales (Andy is Lucia-only; Tyrone and Bret are Jason-only), the remaining stranger strands, the drone races, the shooting-range golds, the collectibles and the free-roam trophies — the VCIA jet, the Rhino tank and the Combat Focus kills.
stages.title: Stage 6 — Post-story cleanup: strands, ranges, collectibles

stages.note: The 100% checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Push past the trophy minimums: 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of the 277 vehicle models, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations. When it hits 100%, A Long Road pops — and the Platinum with it.
stages.title: Stage 7 — The 100% grind and the Platinum
